content.snl: variable(__list__(Type.annotation(@$\mathbb{K}$,Type),Type.annotation(@V,Type),LA.Field($\mathbb{K}$),LA.VectorSpace(V,$\mathbb{K}$),Type.annotation(@ι,Type),Type.annotation(@v,Type.to(ι,V)),Type.annotation(@hi,LA.LinearlyIndependent(v,V))),def[prop](LinearIndependent.Maximal(hi),,$\forall s : \mathrm{Set}\,V,\ \mathrm{LinearIndependent}\ \mathbb{K}\ ((\uparrow) : s \to V) \to \operatorname{range} v \subseteq s \to \operatorname{range} v = s$))

values.zh-CN: 设 $v:\iota\to V$ 线性无关，其独立性证明为 $i:\mathrm{LinearIndependent}\ \mathbb{K}\ v$。Lean 中 `LinearIndependent.Maximal i` 是**关于独立性证明的谓词**（`i.Maximal`），不是关于族本身的谓词：它断言不存在真包含 $\operatorname{range} v$ 的线性无关集，即 $\forall s,\,\mathrm{LinearIndependent}\ \mathbb{K}\ (s\to V)\to \operatorname{range} v\subseteq s\to \operatorname{range} v=s$。因此宏 `LinearIndependent.Maximal` 只接受一个参数——那份独立性证明；族 $v$ 是其隐式参数。
values.en: Let $v:\iota\to V$ be linearly independent with proof $i:\mathrm{LinearIndependent}\ \mathbb{K}\ v$. In Lean `LinearIndependent.Maximal i` is a **predicate on the independence proof** (`i.Maximal`), not a predicate on a family: it says no strictly larger linearly independent set contains $\operatorname{range} v$, i.e. $\forall s,\,\mathrm{LinearIndependent}\ \mathbb{K}\ (s\to V)\to \operatorname{range} v\subseteq s\to \operatorname{range} v=s$. The macro therefore takes exactly one argument, the independence proof; the family $v$ is implicit.
